# HackPSU Travel Reimbursement Policy

Reimbursement Overview

$110

Maximum reimbursement per participant

We're committed to making HackPSU accessible to participants from all locations

Eligible Travel Methods

The following methods of travel are eligible for reimbursement:

### Bus

Public transportation buses

### Plane

Commercial airline flights

### Ride-Sharing

Uber, Lyft, and similar services

### Taxi

Traditional taxi services

### Rental Vehicle

Car rental services

### Personal Vehicle

Gas expenses for your own car

Receipt Requirements

### Required Documentation

- Only the person named on the receipt can be reimbursed
- Verification of initial departure point required
- Digital receipts are accepted for arrival trip only
- Original receipts must be provided at the event

### Important Notes

- Keep all receipts safe until reimbursement is processed
- Each participant must have their own receipt
- Receipts cannot be split among a group

Processing & Timeline

### Processing Time

Reimbursements may take up to 2 months to process after the event.

### How to Submit

Upload your receipts to the reimbursement page by going to the bottom of your profile page and clicking the Submit Reimbursement button.

### HackPSU does NOT reimburse:

#### Travel Restrictions:

- Local transportation within State College
- Travel from the State College area

You are a good candidate if you:

- Are currently enrolled as a full time student (undergraduate, master’s, PhD, or postdoctoral)

- Would be unable to attend without financial assistance

title: 2026-2027 NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship
text:
# 2026-2027 NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship

#### Description

The NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship Fund offers the opportunity for technology and supply chain students to attend the 2027 NRF NXT (formerly called NRF Foundation Student Program) in New York City, free of charge. Retail companies, including some of the most exciting brands in the country, are driving big tech innovation. 

 

The NRF Foundation Student Program introduces exciting career paths that might not have been considered, with sessions highlighting the impact tech, supply chain, fulfillment, and data and analytics jobs have on retail businesses.

 

Undergraduate college students pursuing a technology major (computer science, engineering, data science, etc.) or a supply chain major, you could be eligible to receive FREE travel and hotel accommodations to attend the annual NRF Foundation Student Program in New York City.

 

By attending this conference, you will have the opportunity to meet with dozens of retail recruiters hiring for technology and supply chain roles, hear from top leaders and executives in the industry, and explore the most exciting store locations in NYC.

#### Qualifications

• Undergraduate-level sophomore, junior or senior

• Currently pursuing a technology or supply chain major

• Enrolled full-time at an accredited college or university in the United States

• Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale

• At least one job or internship related to your field of study or area(s)

 The IEEE Robotics & Automation Society works with industry and government entities through the IEEE RAS Industrial Activities Board (IAB). The IAB is responsible for all industry or entrepreneurial related matters, including the growth of the industrial community within RAS. 

The IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS) wants to encourage students to play an active role in existing robotics standardization efforts. IROS 2026 will feature numerous IEEE robotics standardization meetings.

We expect to award 3 travel grants to cover flights and hotel reservations within the IEEE guidelines and not to exceed $2,500 each. Conference registration will be covered as well through issuance of a complimentary registration code. This award is for undergraduate students, and priority will be given to students that would not have otherwise attended IROS (e.g., do not have a paper accepted). title: Student Travel Grants: 2026 LLVM Developers' Meeting
text:
Student Travel Grants: 2026 LLVM Developers' Meeting

The LLVM Foundation is committed to diversity and education in the fields of compilers and tools, and supporting the long term health and growth of the LLVM Project. Therefore, the LLVM Foundation provides travel grants to students attending the LLVM Developers’ Meetings or other compilers and tools related educational conferences.

Applications are open for student travel grants to attend the 2026 LLVM Developers’ Meeting taking place October 27 - 28, 2026 (pre-conference sessions on October 26) at the Santa Clara Marriott.

The deadline for 2026 LLVM Dev Mtg applications is July 17, 2026.

The deadline for student grant applications has passed.

### Selection Criteria

Scholarship recipients are selected based on the following criteria:

- Participation with the LLVM Project or relevant work experience.
- Financial need.
- Priority may be given to those presenting a paper/work using LLVM or related sub-project at the conference/workshop.
- Priority may be given to underrepresented backgrounds, genders, and experiences to encourage broader participation in computer science and engineering.
- Priority may be given to those within the local travel region.
- Past recipients of LLVM Foundation travel grants may not be selected.

### Eligibility

title: New Hudson River Trading CppCon Scholarship | CppCon
text:
New Hudson River Trading CppCon Scholarship | CppCon

# New Hudson River Trading CppCon Scholarship

 Posted on 2026-03-23 2026-03-22 by cppcon 

The generous support of Huds on River Trading has made it possible for CppCon to offer, for the first time, the Hudson River Trading CppCon Scholarship program.

This program will provide scholarships that cover lodging, travel, food, and conference registration for twenty to twenty-five students. Candidates can be graduate or undergraduate, but should be eager to grow as software engineers and quantitative researchers, and have a strong interest in C++.

Attending a technical conference with a world-wide reach like CppCon provides the kind of opportunities to learn from and network with industry-leaders that can change the course of one’s career.

Please feel free to distribute this flyer.

More details and a link to submit an application are available on the scholarship program page.
